detail.title: Superflow 3x120mm ARGB Black Case Fan Kit
detail.overview: Take full command of your PC’s aesthetics and thermal performance with theAnt Esports Superflow 120mm ARGB Case Fan Kit. This all-in-one solution provides everything you need to transform your rig with stunning addressable RGB lighting and efficient, high-performance cooling.Vibrant ARGB Customization:Featuring addressable RGB lighting, these fans deliver a wide spectrum of colors and effects. Use the included remote control to easily switch lighting modes, speeds, and colors to match your gaming style.Efficient Airflow Design:Engineered for optimal cooling, the Superflow fans provide excellent airflow to keep your components stable during long gaming sessions or heavy workloads.Centralized Control Hub:The included hub simplifies cable management and synchronization, allowing you to control multiple fans from one location for a clean and professional build.Universal Compatibility:Designed with standard 120mm dimensions, the Superflow kit is compatible with most PC cases, making it the perfect upgrade for any gaming or enthusiast system.
